entry.title: VirtIO and hypervisors: how virtual devices work
entry.summary: A technical reference on device virtualisation: emulation, VirtIO and assignment; virtqueues and notifications; KVM with vhost, vhost-user and vDPA; Xen grants and IOREQ; QNX, L4Re and Gunyah; VFIO; pKVM and Arm CCA; and virtio-msg.

entry.title: Mixed-criticality on shared silicon: a primer for Physical AI
entry.summary: Where tail latency comes from when AI inference and real-time control share an SoC, why partial isolation falls short, two isolation architectures, measurement discipline, and the EU compliance dates that make it urgent.

entry.title: Case study: TEE trusted services for an automotive telematics unit
entry.summary: Hardened TLS, secure storage and secure logging in OP-TEE for a 5G telematics control unit, toward UN R155 and ISO/SAE 21434 compliance.

entry.title: Case study: secure video streaming for in-flight entertainment
entry.summary: Widevine L1 DRM and aviation-qualified secure boot on NXP i.MX8, designed for certification from day one.
